stem: A crop log says 'flowering' only because the lighting schedule changed yesterday, but no reproductive structures are yet visible. What is the better biological record?
choices: Record the lighting change and separately document plant developmental stage from observed morphology
Mark every plant as fully reproductive immediately
Ignore morphology because schedules define plant anatomy
Classify stage from cultivar name only
rationale: Management events and biological developmental stage are related but not identical; records should distinguish the schedule change from observed plant morphology.
